note: Own engineering paraphrases of the original 14 theory-derived indicator IDs (not new indicators). Dependencies are engineering cautions based on the 2026 table, not formal logical entailment for all theory variants. No status is a consciousness claim.
evidence_policy: All NOT_ASSESSED; architecture existence alone is not causal evidence; no summed consciousness score.

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Local, functionally relevant recurrent computation inside input/perceptual modules
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A recurrent hidden state that never changes perceptual representations

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Structured integration of perceptual information within input processing
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A simple concatenation of independent sensory channels

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Parallel operation of multiple genuinely specialized processing subsystems
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A stack of nominal modules all computing the same fixed feature

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Selective bottleneck or finite-capacity shared workspace
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A fixed one-slot tensor whose content is always the same winner

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Workspace content made functionally available across specialized modules
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A broadcast operation that no downstream module actually uses

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Attention contingent on internal state and serial querying of specialist modules
indicators.minimal_counterexample: An unchanging round-robin scheduler or constant attention bids

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Perceptual representation with generative, top-down or uncertainty-sensitive processing
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A noisy sensor followed by a feedforward classifier

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Metacognitive discrimination of reliable perception from unreliable signals
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A post-hoc output confidence value entirely explained by logits

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Belief and action updates that causally depend on metacognitive monitoring
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A label-reading monitor disconnected from actual decisions

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Representations with structured sparse and continuous quality-like dimensions
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A sparse vector renamed 'qualia' without tested quality-space structure

indicators.computational_paraphrase: An internal predictive model of attentional state that actively controls attention
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A self-state monitor with no access to attention allocation

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Perception based on internal predictive-coding dynamics
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A predictor trained on future reward without error-driven perceptual updating

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Feedback-driven agency flexible across multiple competing goals
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A fixed hard-coded success policy in a single task

indicators.computational_paraphrase: Model of sensorimotor action-to-observation contingencies used for control
indicators.minimal_counterexample: A map of world state that never predicts effects of the agent's own actions
